name: equinix-fabric
description: Operate Equinix Fabric from your agent: search inventory (connections, ports, cloud routers, service tokens, route filters/aggregations, time services); create, update and retry Fabric connections (EVPL, EPL, IP, Internet Access, EVP-LAN/EP-LAN); plan and manage Fabric Networks (EVP-LAN, EVP-Tree, EP-LAN, EP-Tree); and manage Fabric Cloud Routers, BGP, route filters and route aggregations.
